# BROWSE HEARTS [italic]Transcripts of this week's new tapes. Full tapes are in the OreMatch library. Rewind gently.[/italic]
## DUSTY, 38, DRILL OPERATOR Hi. My name is Dusty. That is my real name. My mother saw the future. I have worked a drill for nineteen years and I can tell what rock it is by the sound. I am looking for someone who likes quiet nights, loud machinery and does not mind that I hum the drill noise when I am happy. Here is my one nice thing: I always bring enough coffee for two.
## PRIYA, 29, NIGHT SHIFT COMMS Hello. I am Priya. I listen to static for a living, so I am a very good listener. I like Chroma Sleep, crosswords and any man who can say goodnight at the end of a transmission without making it weird. My friend Marisol says I should smile on the tape. This is me smiling.
## BIG TOMAS, 41, DRILL OPERATOR I am Tomas. People call me Big Tomas because there is a Little Tomas, who is bigger. I am looking for a nice woman who will not move my lunch. My one nice thing: I give good rocks. I once gave someone a rock that looks like a duck.
## JOE-114, WORKING JOE Hello. I am JOE-114. I am a Working Joe. I am declaring that I am a Working Joe. I enjoy sweeping, locking doors and assisting colonists. I am looking for a companion who requires assistance. My one nice thing: I am always available.
[color=#B07090]JOE-114 has three matches. OreMatch is looking into it.[/color]
## CAPTAIN ANYA, 45, HAULER I fly a bulk hauler. I am in hypersleep ten months of the year. If you want a partner who is never home and never ages, I am perfect. I will write to you every time I am awake, so expect two letters a year. They will be long ones.
## NO NAME, AGE NOT GIVEN [color=#B07090]This tape is blank except for the last four seconds, which show the inside of a vent and a sound like breathing. It has been liked eleven times. OreMatch has removed it from the library. It is back in the library.[/color]
